instructions: Run setup once; execute two reserve calls concurrently, then two claim calls concurrently. Expect one reservation and one true claim. Always run cleanup. DB only; synthetic gateway IDs are never sent to a provider.
reserve: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE service_role; WITH r AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT public.reserve_india_shipping_booking('92000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001','91000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001','GS'||substr(md5('92000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'),1,18)) AS reserved) SELECT reserved,pg_sleep(1) FROM r; COMMIT;
claim: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE service_role; WITH c AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT public.claim_india_shipping_booking((SELECT id FROM public.india_shipping_shipments WHERE order_id='92000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'),'91000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') AS claimed) SELECT claimed,pg_sleep(1) FROM c; COMMIT;
cleanup: BEGIN; DELETE FROM public.india_shipping_shipments WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.orders WHERE order_number LIKE 'SHIP-RACE-%' AND id::text LIKE '92000000-%'); DELETE FROM public.india_shipping_destinations WHERE order_id::text LIKE '92000000-%'; DELETE FROM public.india_shipping_preparations WHERE order_id::text LIKE '92000000-%'; DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id::text LIKE '92000000-%'; DELETE FROM public.cashfree_payment_intents WHERE completed_order_id::text LIKE '92000000-%' AND cashfree_order_id LIKE 'SHIP-CONTEXT-SHIP-RACE-%'; DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE id::text LIKE '92000000-%' AND order_number LIKE 'SHIP-RACE-%'; DELETE FROM public.admin_users WHERE user_id::text LIKE '91000000-%' AND email LIKE 'ship-%@example.invalid'; COMMIT;
reconcile: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE service_role; SELECT public.reconcile_india_shipping_booking((SELECT id FROM public.india_shipping_shipments WHERE order_id='92000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001')); SELECT public.claim_india_shipping_booking((SELECT id FROM public.india_shipping_shipments WHERE order_id='92000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'),'91000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') AS reclaim_allowed; COMMIT;
